issues.description: Static method name mismatch for the operation that computes a meal's total price. The problem statement / UML require a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int (see UML line and the note about methods to be static). The template's example usage (commented in Main.java) refers to shop.computeMealCost(...). The solution implementation defines a static method named computeMealCost(Meal) in SealSaloon, while the solution's Main.java calls shop.calculateTotalPrice(...). This inconsistent naming across problem statement, template comments, and solution implementation will confuse students about which method to implement and which name to call.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Option A (recommended): Rename the implemented static method computeMealCost(Meal) in SealSaloon to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) and update any call sites (template comments and solution Main) to call calculateTotalPrice. Option B: If you prefer computeMealCost as the canonical name, update the problem statement/UML and any example calls/comments to require and call computeMealCost instead. After choosing, ensure the method signature (static int methodName(Meal)) and all references in Main.java, the UML in problem_statement.md, and template comments are updated to the same identifier.
